Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the secretary of state to post ballot measure results on its web site.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to availability of election results on thesecretary of state's web site; and adding a new section to chapter29A.60 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Beginning with the 2005 general election, the secretary of stateshall make available on its web site the election results of all statemeasures submitted to the voters. The voting results of measures mustbe made available, at a minimum, by each legislative district and mustbe posted on the web site for five years.
